title: Candy Sync device v1
description: Server-visible device record. Device name and profile icon descriptor remain encrypted; PKCS8 private key and bearer token are forbidden.

encryptedName.description: AES-256-GCM envelope whose HKDF info and AAD bind the exact SHA-256 fingerprint of this record's DER SPKI public key.

encryptedIcon.description: AES-256-GCM envelope for #/$defs/deviceIconDescriptor. HKDF info and AEAD AAD bind the exact SHA-256 fingerprint of this record's DER SPKI public key, so envelopes cannot be swapped between devices. Legacy pre-v2 rows may return null until re-enrolled.

p256Spki.description: DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo for an ECDH P-256 public key, unpadded base64url. Current Web Crypto export is 91 bytes (122 characters).

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of decoded SPKI bytes, exactly 32 bytes encoded as unpadded base64url.

nonce.description: Exactly 12 bytes encoded as unpadded base64url.

ciphertext.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext with included 16-byte tag, unpadded base64url.
Bounded AES-256-GCM ciphertext for a deviceIconDescriptor, including the 16-byte tag.

deviceIconDescriptor.description: Client-only plaintext used to render a stable per-device profile icon. Synced-profile badges derive locally from item type and sync status, never from this descriptor.

catalogId.description: An id from ../device-icons-v1.json. Clients fail closed for ids absent from that versioned catalog.

enrollmentRequest.description: Device enrollment authenticated with HTTP Basic. Recovery envelope is required by server state for the first device and forbidden as a replacement for later devices.

encryptedName.description: Device-name encryption binds deviceKeyFingerprint in both HKDF info and AEAD AAD.
